title: Clean the Lines
goal: Assemble a pipeline that trims lines and filters out empty ones.
hints: Trimming must happen before filtering so whitespace lines become empty.
The filter pattern `|&line|` requires slice references before conversion to `String`.
explanation: `lines()` yields string slices for each line. Mapping `trim()` strips surrounding whitespace while keeping item references as `&str`. Filtering with `|&line| !line.is_empty()` pattern matches `&&str` and discards empty slices. Mapping `to_string()` converts remaining slices into owned `String` values. Finally `collect()` gathers them into `Vec<String>`.
